summary: The diff implements client-side PDF/image processing utilities and wires tool pages to use them via useProcessFile, but it does not add any backend Motoko endpoints, job/chunked upload model, or backend-driven upload→process→download flow as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend tool-processing endpoints in backend/main.mo for PDF→DOCX, image compress, and image resize+compress using a real external API over HTTPS (or real in-canister processing), returning processed bytes + filename + contentType, rejecting unsupported input types, and using structured errors.
missing_requirements.reason: No backend changes are shown at all (no backend/main.mo modifications). Processing is implemented entirely in the frontend via new client-side processors.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a backend job/operation model supporting operation identifiers, (chunked) upload initiation/incremental upload, finalize+process, retrieval of processed bytes+metadata, coarse progress states, and cleanup/retention policy using the existing blob storage mixin.
missing_requirements.reason: No backend API/model for jobs, chunked upload, progress states, blob storage usage, or cleanup is present in the diff; progress is simulated client-side by calling onProgress at fixed steps.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to call the backend for real processing (operation selection, params for resize/compress, upload progress callback, return processedBytes/filename/contentType).
missing_requirements.reason: useProcessFile routes to client-side functions (convertPdfToWord/compressImage/resizeAndCompressImage) and does not call the backend actor for upload/process/download sequencing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update tool pages to use backend-driven processing end-to-end (upload→process→download) and update any privacy/security copy that claims processing is entirely in-browser.
missing_requirements.reason: The pages call useProcessFile, which performs client-side processing; there is no backend-driven workflow. The diff summary does not show any privacy/security copy updates.

hallucinated_features.description: Client-side image compression/resizing using canvas (compressImage, resizeAndCompressImage) with progress updates.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly requires backend processing via Motoko actor and real external API (or real in-canister processing) rather than client-side placeholder processing.

hallucinated_features.description: Client-side PDF-to-Word conversion by extracting text from PDF bytes and emitting a minimal XML payload saved as .docx (not a real DOCX zip structure).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires real backend conversion returning a DOCX output; the diff adds a simplified browser-side approach and even notes it is simplified and not a real DOCX structure.

hallucinated_features.description: New frontend tool-processing helper module (types, filename/content-type generation, file validation) used to support the client-side processing path.
hallucinated_features.reason: While some shared types could be useful, the BuildRequest specifically asks to integrate backend processing; this module supports the unrequested client-side processing implementation.
